title: Vampire Manor
description:
You’ve been invited to a lavish masquerade ball at a centuries-old French château, hosted by its beautiful and mysterious mistress. (Don’t you love when that happens?)

You thought you’d go mostly unnoticed, but the mistress of the manor is unusually fascinated by you.

As the evening unfolds, she invites you away from the festivities and into her library, where centuries-old secrets, forbidden romance, and a supernatural proposition await you.
author: Goddess Nichole
